closing.alt: Exterior cladding and property maintenance detail

winnerContact: After entries close, ANDRO will check submitted entries for clear eligibility or duplicate issues and randomly select one provisionally eligible entry from the remaining entries on Christmas Day, 25 December 2026, at or after 12:00 pm New Zealand daylight time. The selection is by chance, not based on the story or work description. ANDRO will attempt to contact the selected entrant by phone or email within three New Zealand business days of the draw. The selected entrant has seven calendar days from the first contact attempt to respond and establish eligibility and property-owner permission. If the selected entrant is ineligible, declines or does not respond, ANDRO may exclude that entry with a recorded reason and conduct a documented replacement random draw from the remaining eligible entries. A selection is provisional until eligibility and the scope of work are confirmed. The winner's name, image and property details will not be published without their separate permission.
prizeCardFootnote:
Up to 8 hours of one worker's labour.
Materials and additional costs excluded.
prizeNote: Work must be within ANDRO's capabilities, safe, lawful and agreed after a site assessment. Restricted building work, specialist trades, hazardous work, permits and materials are not included.
privacy: Andro Construction Limited (trading as ANDRO Construction + Projects), Auckland, New Zealand, collects name, email address, phone number, Auckland suburb, property relationship, work category and consent choices through the website entry form. A description of jobs around the property is entirely optional. If entering through ANDRO's official Facebook Instant Form, ANDRO receives name, email address, phone number, eligibility and terms responses, any separately collected marketing choice, and submission metadata (including form and lead IDs and submission time) from Meta through Google Sheets. Additional information may be requested from the provisional winner to verify eligibility and organise work. Required contact and eligibility fields are necessary to process an entry; without them or the required agreement, an entry cannot be accepted. A work description is not required and does not affect the chance of winning. Marketing consent is optional, separate from entry and never required to participate; where no separate affirmative marketing choice is collected, no marketing opt-in is recorded. We use entry information to administer the giveaway, detect duplicates and ineligible entries, contact the selected entrant, organise the agreed work, maintain a draw audit and satisfy applicable legal obligations. Separately, only if you affirmatively opt in, ANDRO may use your email address to send exclusive offers, special discounts and other promotional emails. You can unsubscribe at any time. This consent does not cover promotional phone calls or text messages and does not affect your entry or chance of winning. ANDRO uses Cloudflare infrastructure and, for Facebook entries, Meta and Google Sheets to receive and process entry information. Information may be processed outside New Zealand. Meta also processes information under its own privacy policy. Access to ANDRO's records is restricted to authorised personnel and relevant service providers acting for ANDRO. We do not sell entry details, use unconsented entries for marketing or publish a winner's identity without separate permission. We will review ANDRO's records, including copies in Google Sheets and competition processing logs, for secure deletion after the prize is fulfilled, and no later than 30 June 2027 unless longer retention is genuinely required for a legal obligation or a dispute; separate opt-in marketing details may be retained until consent is withdrawn. Entrants can request access to or correction of personal information or raise a privacy concern via andro.co.nz/contact/. Our public business correspondence address is provided in the promoter details on this page.
redemption: The winner and ANDRO will agree a practical work date, subject to availability, weather, site access and safety conditions. The prize should be booked and completed by 31 March 2027 where reasonably practicable; a mutually agreed extension may be needed for weather or other circumstances beyond either party's reasonable control. Work will be discussed and agreed before it starts. Normal applicable consumer rights are not excluded.
howToEnter: Enter once for free during the published entry period, either using the form at andro.co.nz/win or, once made available by ANDRO, its official Facebook Instant Form for this giveaway. Website entrants provide their name, email address, phone number, Auckland suburb, property relationship and type of work; a short description of the jobs is welcome but entirely optional. Facebook entrants provide their name, email address, phone number and affirmative confirmation of eligibility and agreement to these terms. ANDRO will verify the provisionally selected entrant's eligibility, property authority and proposed work before confirming the winner. Existing valid website entries remain valid; there is no need to enter again. The limit is one entry per individual across both methods, regardless of email address. Both methods feed into the same random draw, and all eligible entries have an equal chance of selection. A purchase, booking, paid service, Facebook/Instagram follow, like, share, referral or marketing subscription is NOT required.
eligibility: Open to individuals aged 18 or over who can lawfully authorise work at one property located in the mainland Auckland Council region and reachable by public roads without ferry or air travel. Properties on Waiheke, Aotea / Great Barrier and other offshore islands are excluded. Entrants must be the owner, an authorised property manager or a tenant with the property owner's permission; written owner authority may be requested before work is booked. ANDRO staff and their immediate families are excluded. Limit one entry per individual, regardless of email address. Duplicate, fraudulent or otherwise ineligible entries may be excluded on reasonable documented grounds before the draw.
promoter: Andro Construction Limited, trading as ANDRO Construction + Projects, Auckland, New Zealand. Competition enquiries, prize arrangements and privacy requests can be made using andro.co.nz/contact/. ANDRO's business correspondence address is displayed in the promoter details on this page.
prizeTerms: There is one prize: up to eight hours of on-site labour by one ANDRO worker, on one agreed working day at one eligible mainland Auckland property, for suitable minor property maintenance, handyman tasks or minor non-restricted building repairs. This is a labour-only prize, not eight hours of an entire crew or a completed renovation. Materials and consumables, specialist trades or subcontractors, equipment hire, rubbish removal, permits and consent costs, and work beyond the eight-hour allowance are not included. The prize does not require the winner to purchase anything from ANDRO; eligible tasks using existing or owner-supplied materials can be agreed. If an item needs materials, the winner can supply them themselves; they are never required to buy them from ANDRO. Any paid extras must be entirely optional and agreed separately in writing in advance. No cash alternative; the prize is not transferable.
heroLead: A day's worth of labour to help tackle the jobs around your property. From general maintenance and handyman work to eligible minor building repairs, tell us what you need a hand with.
socialMedia: This promotion is administered solely by Andro Construction Limited and is not sponsored, endorsed or administered by, or associated with, Facebook, Instagram or Meta. To the extent permitted by applicable law, entrants release Facebook and Instagram from claims arising from ANDRO's administration of this promotion. Where an entrant uses the Facebook Instant Form, Meta processes and transfers the submitted information to ANDRO as described in the privacy notice and Meta's own privacy policy. No like, follow, tag or share is required to enter.
workRestrictions: ANDRO will agree the exact tasks with the confirmed winner after an appropriate site assessment. Work must be within the worker's competence, safe, lawful and technically suitable. The prize excludes restricted building work, structural changes, building work requiring building consent, licensed electrical, plumbing or gas work, asbestos and other hazardous materials, unsafe height or access work and specialist certifications. Work carried out under any building-consent exemption must still comply with the Building Code, and relevant Auckland Council resource-consent restrictions may still apply. If the original tasks are not suitable, the winner may choose other eligible tasks within the same labour-only allowance. ANDRO will not promise or undertake unsafe or unlawful work.
prizeIntro: We're giving one eligible Auckland entrant up to eight hours of one worker's labour towards agreed property maintenance, handyman or minor building work.
